pr_title: Fix break overlay grade changing to 'F' when exiting play
pr_comments: Would very much appreciate test coverage of this.

issue_context.title: Grade display (?) update way too fast when returning to song select.
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

Replicated while viewing replay.
When returning to song select, the grade display (?) during break time is instantly changed from the current grade to **F** before fully returning.

I expect it not to change to **F** grade before fully returning to song select. 
I'm not sure if this also happens while playing. And even if it did then it's too obstructed by the menu to be noticeable anyway

### Screenshots or videos

Video recorded on OBS Studio 29.0.2 (64 bits) and edited with Shotcut 22.06.23

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43719333/220608571-9e2c6db7-d94a-44cf-9b34-bec000b3eea1.mp4



### Version

osu! 2023.207.0-lazer

### Logs

[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10803271/performance.log)
[database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10803272/database.log)

review_comments: This can't be in `Player.cs`. At most, this could be a method call on `BreakOverlay`, but I'm not sure this is the correct place to fix this. Would it not make more sense that `ScoreProcessor`'s rank doesn't change after the exit process beings, rather than just hiding the fact that it changed from being displayed?
I could move the logic in `Player` for failing on early exit over to `SubmittingPlayer` so that it only effects the submission itself.
I'm not sure which logic you're talking about, so you'd need to provide a diff or something.
Rather than exposing this, please use `ChildrenOfType<BreakInfo>.Single()` in the test (check other tests for examples).
